name: Print String
description: Prints a string to the log and optionally to the screen. If 'Print to Log' is true, it will be visible in the Output Log window. Otherwise it will be logged only as 'Verbose'. Target is Kismet System Library.

inputs.name: In String
inputs.description: The string to log out. Connect a literal string, an Append String result, or the output of any node returning a string.

inputs.name: Print to Screen
inputs.description: Whether or not to print the output to the screen (on-screen debug message).

inputs.name: Print to Log
inputs.description: Whether or not to print the output to the Output Log. When false, the message is logged only as 'Verbose' and generally won't show up.

inputs.name: Text Color
inputs.description: The color of the text to display on screen. Connect a Make Linear Color or a color variable.

inputs.name: Duration
inputs.description: How long, in seconds, the on-screen message remains visible (if Print to Screen is true). A negative number loads the duration from the config.

inputs.name: Key
inputs.description: If a non-empty key is provided, the message will replace any existing on-screen messages with the same key. Leave empty to always add a new line.

outputs.name: Out
outputs.description: Execution pin that fires immediately after the string is dispatched. Use it to continue the graph.
